messages:
Nina - SRE: Opening follow-up for last-night's streaming partial-response + silent-close. Quick owner list and short actions.
Omar R: Saw samples where client received half-chunk then socket FIN. Suspect LB idle or upstream preemption.
Priya K: I'll run ALB idle-timeout canary at 180s and post metrics.
Luis: I'll add a tcpdump job on two ingress nodes for 4h and filter for FIN/RST around streaming endpoints.
DevBot: Ticket INFRA-1344 created for ALB change.
Nina - SRE: Owners: Priya=infra canary+rollback plan, Luis=pcap capture+upload, Omar=runtime detection + grafana panel, Maya=comms + PM update.
Maya S: Proposed immediate mitigations: enable SO_KEEPALIVE and send lightweight heartbeat every 12s from runtime. Low-risk.
Omar R: Also adding detection metric partial_chunks/total_chunks; alert warn at 0.1% for 10m. I'll push panel.
Luis: Capture scheduled in 30m, will upload pcaps to incident dir.
Priya K: Canary started, will report in 2h.
Maya S: Timeline: detection+alert in 12h, ALB canary in 24h, heartbeat + SDK patch in 48h, pcap analysis in 72h, customer note in 96h. Quick sync tomorrow 09:30. Ping here for blockers. :white_check_mark:
